# alphaTab 1.8.4

Unmodified browser distribution from `@coderline/alphatab@1.8.4` (npm), pinned and served locally. Package integrity verified against the registry SHA-512 on download. No CDN is required at runtime.

Source: https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab (release v1.8.4).
Library license: Mozilla Public License 2.0; see LICENSE.
Bravura fonts: SIL Open Font License; see font/Bravura-OFL.txt.
Only the UMD browser bundle and WOFF/WOFF2 fonts are needed: external-media playback does not need a synthesizer soundfont.
